title: Coriolis
premise: Every piece in the map is a turned or angled face, so a straight throw comes back curved. The centre third is left empty for the kickoff; the first contest is a band of angled vanes, the second a ring you either thread or go around.

envelope.note: Measured off the stock arena's own player-collision body, not estimated. The playfield is goal to goal; the tunnels and spawn chambers behind each goal keep their stock shape so the launchers and respawns work unchanged.

anchors.note: Fixed. These come from the stock level and must not move, or the match logic breaks.

symmetry.rule: 180 degrees about y: (x, y, z) -> (-x, y, -z)
symmetry.why: The stock arena's own symmetry. Authoring one half and generating the other means the two ends cannot drift apart, so neither team gets the better side.

geometry.note: Five models, 22 placements. Positions are the z > 0 half; the other half is generated by the symmetry rule.

models.role: The signature piece and the main funnel to the goal. Thread the hole for the direct line, or go around and lose tempo.
First contest out of the kickoff. Angled so a flat pass off one deflects across the lane instead of returning.
Side-lane cover and the main grab point for a boost turn.
Breaks the sight line to the goal from above and below without narrowing the mouth.
Wall rail. A continuous grab line so the outside route stays fast.

lighting.note: Colours and intensities are the stock arena's measured values, kept because they are what makes an Echo map read as one. The plan is simplified: fewer, better-placed fixtures.

fixtures.role: Warm key from the orange end.
Cool fill from the blue end.
Ten per goal mouth, ringing the aperture.
Sixteen per gate ring; team colour by end, so the ring reads as yours or theirs at a glance.
Twelve along each rail, neutral white, so the outside route is legible from the middle.
Four at the disc spawn. Neutral, so the kickoff belongs to neither side.

materials.role: The hull. Every wall, and the vanes and drums that read as part of it.
Structural plate: the shelves, and the goal surround.
The gate rings. Brighter and more specular than the hull so the funnel stands out.
Wall rails. Banded, so speed along them is readable in peripheral vision.
The rim strips. One emissive with a per-end colour, warm at +z and cool at -z.
